hooks.name: CreateAndStoreBackpackItem
hooks.readback: slot instances, owner and resource after a backpack item was created and stored

hooks.name: TryClearSlot
hooks.readback: retire lives whose slot item or instance no longer reads back

hooks.name: DestroyAllInstance
hooks.readback: retire lives whose instances were destroyed

hooks.name: SetDeployed
hooks.readback: per-slot deployed marker of the same backpack after the deploy or pickup body; a deployed slot reads back as a Deployed location without a slot or wield state. The deployed world instance itself is not an identity here

hooks.name: DoWieldItem
hooks.readback: WieldedItem of the local inventory after the wield body

hooks.name: UnWield
hooks.readback: WieldedItem of the local inventory after the override body

hooks.name: DoEquipItem
hooks.readback: WieldedItem of a synced inventory after the equip body

hooks.name: UnWield
hooks.readback: WieldedItem of a synced inventory after the override body
